source: IACB Source Directory of American Indian & Alaska Native Owned and Operated Arts and Crafts Businesses
publisher: Indian Arts and Crafts Board, U.S. Department of the Interior
native_identifiability: 500+ businesses: cooperatives, tribal arts/crafts ENTERPRISES, and privately owned galleries/businesses of enrolled members of federally recognized tribes; free to list, restricted to federally recognized tribal members and tribally run businesses
identity_semantics: Strongest identity basis in this frame: listing requires enrolled membership in a federally recognized tribe (or tribal enterprise), and the directory backs the Indian Arts and Crafts Act (18 USC 1159 / 25 USC 305e) enforcement regime. MIXED ownership classes — tribal enterprises (tribally_owned) AND individually owned businesses in one list; label per entry, do not bulk-assign. PERSON BOUNDARY: individual artist/craftsperson listings are person records — not ingestible pre-FIELD_CLASSIFICATION
export: web directory on doi.gov/iacb; FR notices (2023-25103) cover the information collection
notes: NEW FRAME: Native ag/tourism/arts registries. This is the arts pillar and the single strongest cross-reference of the three — federal, enrollment-verified, statute-backed. Cross-Reference candidate; the enterprise/cooperative rows are the ingestible part, the individual-artist rows carry the person boundary. nation_ids: [] (national, all federally recognized tribes).

source: IAC American Indian Foods — Producer Directory (“Made/Produced by American Indians” trademark)
publisher: Intertribal Agriculture Council (IAC), American Indian Foods program
native_identifiability: Online directory of producers CERTIFIED to use the 'Made/Produced by American Indians' trademark; 500+ licensed users since 1993; eligibility = federally recognized tribal member, tribal entity, or Alaskan Village, or a controlling 51% share interest
identity_semantics: Real ownership rule (≥51% controlling interest or tribal member/entity) + a certification mark — stronger than membership/self-ID. MIXED classes (individual producers, tribal entities). PERSON BOUNDARY on individual producer records. Trademark certification is an identity signal, not by itself a tribal-citizenship assertion for a specific nation
notes: The agriculture/food pillar. IAC also runs the USDA-funded National Intertribal Food Business Center (indianag.org/intertribalfbc) — a separate technical-assistance channel, not a roster. Cross-Reference candidate with a 51% do_not_infer. nation_ids: [] (national).
